title: epilobium montanum proles carpetanum
intro: Epilobium montanum proles carpetanum, commonly known as the Alpine Willowherb, is a subspecies of the flowering plant Epilobium montanum. This plant is used in herbal medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, as well as its ability to support kidney function and reduce edema. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Willowherb are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. Overall, the Alpine Willowherb has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and skin conditions, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
